title: payments-deploy-production-spreedly-create-payment-gateway.md
content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Create a Spreedly Payment Gateway ## slug: payments-deploy-production-spreedly-create-payment-gateway ## seoTitle: Connect a Spreedly Payment Gateway ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End 1. Contact {{variable.Link_BlackthornSupport}} to obtain a live mode Spreedly Environment Key. *The live mode key is different than the test mode key.* 2. Navigate to the {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} object. 3. Click {{variable.button_new}}. ![deploy_spreedly_create_gateway_1](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/deploy_spreedly_create_gateway_1.png){height="" width=""} 5. Enter a {{variable.Field_PG_PaymentGatewayName}}. ![deploy_spreedly_create_gateway_2](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/deploy_spreedly_create_gateway_2.png){height="" width=""} 7. Set {{variable.Field_PaymentGateway_Provider}} = “Spreedly”. ![deploy_spreedly_create_gateway_3](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/deploy_spreedly_create_gateway_3.png){height="" width=""} 9. Leave the {{variable.Field_PG_TestMode}} checkbox unchecked for a live {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} in production. ![deploy_spreedly_create_gateway_4](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/deploy_spreedly_create_gateway_4.png){height="" width=""} 11. Populate the {{variable.Field_PG_DefaultCurrency}} and {{variable.Field_PG_DefaultCountry}} fields. ![deploy_spreedly_create_gateway_5](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/deploy_spreedly_create_gateway_5.png){height="" width=""} 13. Enter the live mode key provided by Blackthorn Support in the {{variable.Field_PG_SpreedlyEnviroKey}} field. ![deploy_spreedly_create_gateway_6](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/deploy_spreedly_create_gateway_6.png){height="" width=""} 15. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. ![deploy_spreedly_create_gateway_7](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/deploy_spreedly_create_gateway_7.png){height="" width=""} 17. Click the {{variable.Button_PG_CreateSpreedlyGatewa}} button. 18. Select the Payment Gateway you want to connect (Ex. CardConnect; EBANX). 19. If prompted, add additional information from the selected gateway. 20. Click {{variable.Permission_Create}}. 21. The {{variable.Field_PG_SpreedlyConfigGateway}} and {{variable.Field_PG_GatewayToken}} fields will be populated automatically. ### Add a CyberSource Payment Gateway {{snippet.Deploy_Spreedly_CybersourcePG}}
